physics-killer-01.title: Rayilii roolarkoostarii miidhaa hin
physics-killer-01.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-01.material: Rayilii roolarkoostarii miidhaa hin qabne irratti wanti tokko bakka A ol-ka'iinsa $50\,\mathrm{m}$ irraa dhaabbataa jalqaba. Ol-ka'iinsi iddoowwan sadii rayilii irra jiran akka gabateetti: iddoo B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame fi $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ yoo ta'e, (saffisni C irratti) saffisa B irratti meeqa dachaa ta'uu fi saffisni D irratti hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Rayilii roolarkoostarii miidhaa hin qabne irratti wanti tokko bakka A ol-ka'iinsa $50\,\mathrm{m}$ irraa dhaabbataa jalqaba. Ol-ka'iinsi iddoowwan sadii rayilii irra jiran akka gabateetti: iddoo B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame fi $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ yoo ta'e, (saffisni C irratti) saffisa B irratti meeqa dachaa ta'uu fi saffisni D irratti hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: A irratti dhaabbataa waan ta'eef $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ irraa $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kanaaf $v_C/v_B=2$ dachaa, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Saffisni ol-ka'iinsa gad-bu'e wajjin madaalaa miti, $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ wajjin madaalaa dha (deebii dogoggoraa ①); ol-ka'iinsa D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ ol-ka'iinsa gad-bu'e yoo fudhatan $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ③), $\frac12$ yoo dhiisan $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ④) ta'a.
physics-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-01.steps.0.prompt: Rayilii roolarkoostarii miidhaa hin qabne irratti wanti tokko bakka A ol-ka'iinsa $50\,\mathrm{m}$ irraa dhaabbataa jalqaba. Ol-ka'iinsi iddoowwan sadii rayilii irra jiran akka gabateetti: iddoo B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, iddoo D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame fi $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ yoo ta'e, (saffisni C irratti) saffisa B irratti meeqa dachaa ta'uu fi saffisni D irratti hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-01.steps.0.explain: A irratti dhaabbataa waan ta'eef $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ irraa $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kanaaf $v_C/v_B=2$ dachaa, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Saffisni ol-ka'iinsa gad-bu'e wajjin madaalaa miti, $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ wajjin madaalaa dha (deebii dogoggoraa ①); ol-ka'iinsa D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ ol-ka'iinsa gad-bu'e yoo fudhatan $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ③), $\frac12$ yoo dhiisan $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ④) ta'a.
physics-killer-01.steps.1.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.steps.1.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
